title: Markup re-run renames the clips it made
description: plan_merge matches existing ML clips by a kind field the Clip model doesn't have, so clips a merge created never match on the next run: they get new names and the old ones are retired or deleted. Derive the kind from the clip's tags or name prefix (loop-2 -> loop).
